hints.title: Running Sum Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain the running sum of all even numbers so queries do not need to rescan the full array.

hints.title: Delta Parity Transitions
hints.text: Before modifying nums[index], if nums[index] is even, subtract it from the running sum. After adding val, if the new value is even, add it back.

hints.title: Single Query Update
hints.text: Compute initial even_sum = sum(x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0). For each [val, idx] in queries: if nums[idx] % 2 == 0, even_sum -= nums[idx]. nums[idx] += val. If nums[idx] % 2 == 0, even_sum += nums[idx]. Append even_sum to result list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing the even sum after each query takes O(N * Q) time, causing TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Delta updates run in O(1) time per query with O(Q) output array space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain running state rather than recomputing from scratch on each query.
complexity.notes: Handles negative even numbers correctly since (-4) % 2 == 0.
